title: Siege Labourer
subtitle: Hand of the Siege Train
bodyText: A siege labourer moves timber, rope, and stone where the builders need them. Endurance turns the engineer's design into solid material, raising the patient groundwork beneath a machine meant to challenge walls.
sceneBrief: A plain-clothed siege labourer carries timber or coils of heavy rope at a construction yard, unfinished timber tower behind; no advanced engineering instruments.
rarityCharacteristics: plain iron, single rule, square corner joints
